usedFor: Cardly sends the cards, and Calendly creates a booking link when “QR Code Scanned” reports who looked.

bestTemplate.name: “QR Code Scanned” in Cardly, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A scan shows real interest, so the booking link is made for someone who just engaged.

watchOut: Pick one Cardly trigger, because “Gift Card Redeemed”, “QR Code Scanned” and order events can all start “Create Scheduling Link”.
